I am a process-driven IT and systems professional with a Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity from UTSA and an active CompTIA Security+ certification.

Currently, I work as a Service Desk Analyst with Tyto Athene, where my day-to-day focus is keeping critical business infrastructure fully functional. I handle end-to-end technical triage, root-cause diagnostics, and software/hardware troubleshooting within the ServiceNow ecosystem. I also regularly use Microsoft Intune to monitor endpoint health, deploy configurations, and ensure system compliance.

Because this Systems Analyst role demands a deep understanding of network infrastructure and system integration, I’ve spent significant time outside of my daily core operations building and testing independent environments. This includes designing complex enterprise network topologies, Layer 2/3 switching, and VLAN segregation inside Cisco Packet Tracer, as well as deploying Windows Server instances and Active Directory frameworks within VirtualBox sandbox environments to master automated workflows and identity access.

What really drew me to this position with Chick-fil-A is the unique operational scale. Managing systems integration for a high-volume franchise network requires absolute uptime, rapid troubleshooting, and a calm demeanor under pressure—qualities I refined while working as a corporate security professional with Allied Universal. I’m incredibly excited about this opportunity because it allows me to bring my blended background in enterprise IT support, rigorous network/systems testing, and full schedule flexibility to ensure your technology stack runs seamlessly every single day.
